scope: Synthetic Linux CPU scheduler regression; no GPU numerical or performance claim
finding: Root creation does not set worker.last_root; the first request clears its already prepared root and invokes release before execution. Routine end-of-job releases are deliberately excluded from this assertion.

earlier_attempts.reason: Copied frozen test directory was read-only; upload failed, so unittest could not import the new module
Initial assertions included routine post-request releases. Corrected tests inspect count at execution and wait separately for worker cleanup.

next: Measure current real-client baseline, then test a minimal root-residency correction and rerun ownership, publication and branch-switch regressions. No gate qualified.
